# NoiceSS
> Beautiful Screenshot Mockup Studio

NoiceSS is an open-source web application that allows users to create stunning 3D screenshot mockups.
Users can upload an image, apply a macOS window frame, add 3D perspective transforms, and place the image over beautiful radiant glassmorphism backdrops.

Features:
- Free and open-source
- 100% client-side rendering (privacy friendly)
- High resolution export (up to 4x/8x scale)
- Developed by Shivam Gaur

Link: https://noicess.fun
Author: https://shivamgaur.space
GitHub: https://github.com/ishivamgaur/noiceSS
